verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API, an official MCP server, an OpenAPI spec and a docs playground, but no official Morph CLI. The only CLI mention is a community member using the third-party llm.datasette.io tool against the OpenAI-compatible endpoint. That is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
